title: Agent connection bulk-assignment moved to Connections -> Defaults -> Agents
skill_evidence: references/agents.md:425 "(v2.4.4, #5539) ... and the Agents panel has a bulk action that points every agent at one connection or resets them all to the agents default." (contradicts references/architecture.md:67 "Defaults -> Agents also holds the agent bulk-assignment control and the paid-default warning toggle (v2.4.6, #5767)")
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:1021 (2.4.6) "Moved the agent connection bulk assignment control from the Agents panel to Connections -> Defaults -> Agents."; CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:1074 (2.4.6, #5767) adds a Connections -> Defaults -> Agents toggle hiding the recurring default-connection warning. Code: the 'Set every agent's connection' label (en.json ui.panels.agentspanel.bulkConnectionLabel) is rendered only in packages/client/src/components/panels/ConnectionsPanel.tsx:1019.

Matches architecture.md:67.

title: Custom agent repositories: 'no .env change needed' contradicts ENABLE_CUSTOM_AGENT_REPOS requirement
skill_evidence: references/agents.md:345 "External imports (files, folders, custom repositories) are locked until Settings -> Advanced -> Danger Zone -> Allow custom Agent imports is on — no `.env` change needed." vs agents.md:72 "To turn it on: set `ENABLE_CUSTOM_AGENT_REPOS=true` on the server, enable ... Allow custom Agent imports" (and rulesets.md:100 also requires the env var)
reality: Custom Sources is gated by the env var in code: packages/server/src/config/runtime-config.ts:712-714 isCustomAgentRepositoriesEnabled() reads ENABLE_CUSTOM_AGENT_REPOS (.env.example:214 default false). docs/CONFIGURATION.md:39 requires both the env var and the Danger Zone switch for repositories; docs/CONFIGURATION.md:32 ('files, folders, and custom repositories ... does not require an environment variable') is itself ambiguous and is where the skill's wording came from. CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:799 (2.5.0) confirms repositories now also carry rulesets. Code wins: files/folders need only the switch; repositories need the env var too.
fix: agents.md:345: 'Agent files and folders are locked until ... Allow custom Agent imports is on (no .env change needed); custom repositories additionally need ENABLE_CUSTOM_AGENT_REPOS=true (see Custom GitHub agent repositories above).'

title: Advanced Memory off does not restore basic Memory Recall (#7150)
skill_evidence: references/agents.md:368 "While on, it owns retrieval (Standard Recall won't insert a second copy) and replaces the ordinary automatic Roleplay summary schedule; turning it off restores both." (the table at agents.md:353 already states the #7150 mutual exclusivity)
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:43 (2.5.0, #7150) "Enabling Advanced Memory turns off basic Memory Recall, and enabling basic recall turns off Advanced Memory and stops its running work." Code: packages/server/src/services/storage/chats.storage.ts:264-278 exclusiveMemoryRecallPatch writes enableMemoryRecall:false when Advanced is enabled, and 'disables preserve the other mode' — so switching Advanced off leaves basic recall off. The client shows the Memory Recall switch off while Advanced is on (ChatSettingsDrawer.tsx:4549-4551). docs/agents/memory.md:130 still says 'Turning Advanced Memory off restores those normal settings' (doc lag; code wins).
fix: agents.md:368: 'Turning it on switches basic Memory Recall off (v2.5.0, #7150) and replaces the ordinary automatic Roleplay summary schedule. Turning it off restores the summary schedule, but Memory Recall stays off until you switch it back on.' Drop the 'Standard Recall won't insert a second copy' clause (the switch is now forced off).

title: Lorebook Keeper entry omits v2.5.0 source-message provenance (delete/regenerate cleanup)
skill_evidence: references/agents.md:135 `lorebook-keeper` entry covers Target Lorebook (#5907) and alias routing only; no provenance or cleanup on delete/swipe
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:809-811 (2.5.0): deleting messages cleans up lore agents extracted from them (in-place rewrites undone, entries whose whole source turn is gone removed, hand-written entries untouched); regenerating drops lore written from the discarded swipe and swiping back restores it; entries can be filtered by source message. CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:30 (#7146): restoring a trashed message brings back the lorebook changes an agent made with it. Already documented in references/lorebooks.md:32 and :384.
fix: agents.md:135 append: '(v2.5.0) Keeper entries remember their source messages: deleting or regenerating a turn removes or undoes the lore written from it (restoring a trashed message brings it back) -> lorebooks.md (Agent-written lore).'

title: Long-Term Memory v2.5.0 behavior changes missing (recall window, connection refresh, profile-restore refusal)
skill_evidence: references/agents.md:151 `long-term-memory` entry and agents.md:357 memory-surfaces row: no v2.5.0 notes
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:90 (#7044) LTM recall reads only actual conversation history — preset prompts and agent injections no longer fill the package's recent-message window. CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:45 (#7042) saving a connection change that affects LTM waits for the package's index refresh and reports refresh success/failure separately from the save. CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:88 (#7043) restoring a settings profile with LTM while the package is active waits for in-progress reads/rebuilds; if the installed package is too old to coordinate, Marinara refuses the restore and asks you to update or disable it.
fix: agents.md:151 add one line: '(v2.5.0) Recall reads only real chat history (#7044); connection edits that affect it wait for and report an index refresh (#7042); a profile restore with an outdated LTM package is refused until you update or disable the package (#7043).'

title: Activation questions: thinking-first local Decision models don't gate pre-reply agents by default
skill_evidence: references/agents.md:264 'with no Decision model, a timeout or a bad answer, the agent runs normally (fails open)' — no mention of the reasoning-model deferral
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:573 (2.5.0) a **Thinking** setting handles local models that always reason first; 'those gate post-processing agents by default so replies do not wait'. docs/connections/decision-models.md:81 — such a model gives no answer in front of the reply unless **Also gate agents that run before the reply** is on, so a pre-generation/parallel agent's question is skipped and the agent runs. Covered in references/conditional-prompts.md:49 but not where agents.md lists the fail-open cases.
fix: agents.md:264 fail-open list: add 'or a thinking-first local Decision model asked before the reply (pre-generation/parallel agents run ungated unless **Also gate agents that run before the reply** is on -> conditional-prompts.md)'.
